steps.title: PingOne Privilege desktop app
steps.what: The PingOne Privilege desktop app (macOS) pairs one user to one workstation.
steps.why: Privilege is designed to refuse access from a machine that is not a paired device, so that access is tied to a specific workstation and a specific person.

steps.title: Onboarding link generated in the PingOne admi…
steps.what: A user with the Privilege services permission generates a one-time onboarding link, documented as valid for about 2 hours; opening it on the Mac and choosing Launch Agent completes pairing.
steps.why: Privilege is designed to refuse access from a machine that is not a paired device, so that access is tied to a specific workstation and a specific person.

steps.why: Privilege is designed to refuse access from a machine that is not a paired device, so that access is tied to a specific workstation and a specific person.
